WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.718349 40.502899)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.718349 40.502899)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'living_street'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.718349 40.502899)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

```sql
WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-78.718349, 40.502899), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
nearest_road AS (
  SELECT 
    r.id,
    r.geometry,
    ST_Distance(p.geom, r.geometry) AS distance_m
  FROM 
    poi_geom p,
    roads r
  WHERE 
    r.highway = 'living_street'
    AND ST_Distance(p.geom, r.geometry) = (
      SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom, r2.geometry))
      FROM roads r2
      WHERE r2.highway = 'living_street'
    )
  LIMIT 1
),
road_profile AS (
  SELECT 
    nr.geometry,
    nr.distance_m,
    ST_Area(ST_Envelope(nr.geometry)) / 1000000 AS road_length_km,
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(
        r.rast,
        nr.geometry::geometry,
        TRUE
      ),
      1
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM 
    nearest_road nr
  CROSS JOIN 
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast::geometry, nr.geometry::geometry)
),
slope_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Stats(slope_rast, 1, TRUE) AS stats
  FROM 
    road_profile
)
SELECT 
  'Nathan''s Divided Nature Education Center, Ebensburg, PA' AS feature_name,
  nr.distance_m AS separation_meters,
  ROUND(ss.stats.mean * 100, 2) AS average_grade_percent
FROM 
  nearest_road nr,
  slope_stats ss;
```
